# Redis Iris support assistant architecture

An AI support assistant for a made-up outdoor-gear shop, built on Redis Iris one layer at a time. The app embeds each question on your machine and finds the closest help articles with Redis Search in your own database. Three hosted Iris services add to it: LangCache reuses answers to questions asked in other words, Context Retriever gives the model tools over the shop's JSON records, and Agent Memory keeps what each customer said. The LLM writes every answer from the context the app assembles.

**Highlights**

- Every credential comes from `.env`: `REDIS_URL`, `LLM_API_KEY`, `LANGCACHE_API_KEY`, `CTX_ADMIN_KEY`, and `MEMORY_API_KEY`.
- Creating a Context Retriever surface sends the database password from `REDIS_URL` to the hosted service, which keeps it until the surface is deleted.
- The admin key only creates and deletes surfaces. Tool calls carry a separate agent key, which expires after 90 days.
- The app's own Redis data expires: help articles and shop records after an hour, cached answers after 15 minutes.
- Customers are kept apart by id: Agent Memory filters on `ownerId` before it ranks by meaning.

## Components

| Component | Kind | Runs in | Responsibility | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Customer**<br><sub>Priya or Tom in the demo</sub> | client | — | Asks the support assistant about products, care, and their own orders. | [`src/cairn_support/sample_data.py`](../../src/cairn_support/sample_data.py) |
| **Support assistant app**<br><sub>Python (marimo notebook)</sub> | service | Your machine | Assembles each answer's context from search, cache, tools, and memory, and asks the LLM to write it. | [`notebooks/learn_iris_101.py`](../../notebooks/learn_iris_101.py), [`src/cairn_support/`](../../src/cairn_support/) |
| **Embedding model**<br><sub>potion-base-8M, local</sub> | module | Your machine | Turns questions and articles into 256-number vectors on your machine, with no API call. | [`src/cairn_support/embedder.py`](../../src/cairn_support/embedder.py) |
| **Your Redis database**<br><sub>Redis 8, Search and JSON</sub> | datastore | Your Redis Cloud account | Holds the help center index and the shop's JSON records, and backs the Iris services' indexes. | [`notebooks/learn_iris_101.py`](../../notebooks/learn_iris_101.py), [`src/cairn_support/redis_search_replies.py`](../../src/cairn_support/redis_search_replies.py) |
| **LangCache**<br><sub>HTTP, Bearer API key</sub> | external | Redis Iris services | Semantic cache: returns a stored answer when a new question means the same thing. | [`notebooks/learn_iris_101.py`](../../notebooks/learn_iris_101.py) |
| **Context Retriever**<br><sub>MCP over HTTP</sub> | external | Redis Iris services | Turns a declared data model into tools and answers each tool call from the JSON records. | [`notebooks/learn_iris_101.py`](../../notebooks/learn_iris_101.py) |
| **Agent Memory**<br><sub>redis-agent-memory SDK</sub> | external | Redis Iris services | Keeps each chat as session memory and recalls each customer's long-term memories by meaning. | [`notebooks/learn_iris_101.py`](../../notebooks/learn_iris_101.py), [`pyproject.toml`](../../pyproject.toml) |
| **LLM**<br><sub>OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini</sub> | external | LLM provider | Writes each answer from the prompt the app assembles, calling tools when it needs records. | [`src/cairn_support/llm.py`](../../src/cairn_support/llm.py) |

## Where state lives

| Store | Runs in | Holds | Lifetime | Reached by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Your Redis database** | Your Redis Cloud account | Help articles with vectors (hashes) | 1 hour | Support assistant app, Context Retriever, LangCache, Agent Memory |
| **Your Redis database** | Your Redis Cloud account | Customers, products, orders (JSON) | 1 hour | Support assistant app, Context Retriever, LangCache, Agent Memory |
| **Your Redis database** | Your Redis Cloud account | LangCache and Agent Memory indexes | managed by each service | Support assistant app, Context Retriever, LangCache, Agent Memory |

## Flows

### One support turn

Priya asks a question in a new chat (Chapter 4). Every layer adds to what the model sees.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant c_customer as Customer
  participant c_support_app as Support assistant app
  participant c_agent_memory as Agent Memory
  participant c_embedding_model as Embedding model
  participant c_redis_db as Your Redis database
  participant c_context_retriever as Context Retriever
  participant c_llm as LLM
  c_customer->>c_support_app: Which sleeping bag should I get for the trip?
  c_support_app->>c_agent_memory: save to session, recall her memories (ownerId filter)
  c_agent_memory-->>c_support_app: allergic to down, paddling in Maine in June
  c_support_app->>c_embedding_model: embed the question
  c_support_app->>c_redis_db: FT.SEARCH KNN over help articles
  c_redis_db-->>c_support_app: closest articles
  c_support_app->>c_context_retriever: tools/list (agent key)
  c_support_app->>c_llm: system prompt, chat, tools
  c_llm-->>c_support_app: tool call, or the answer
  c_support_app->>c_context_retriever: tools/call for her orders
  c_support_app-->>c_customer: answer that remembers her
```

### Cache-aside answer

A care question everyone asks (Chapter 2). A hit skips the model; a miss stores the new answer.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant c_support_app as Support assistant app
  participant c_langcache as LangCache
  participant c_redis_db as Your Redis database
  participant c_llm as LLM
  c_support_app->>c_langcache: POST /entries/search: prompt, similarityThreshold
  c_langcache-->>c_support_app: best entry above the threshold, or none
  c_support_app->>c_redis_db: on a miss: FT.SEARCH for help articles
  c_support_app->>c_llm: on a miss: question with those articles
  c_support_app->>c_langcache: POST /entries: prompt, response, 15-minute TTL
```

### Creating a Context Retriever surface

Run once before tool calls (Chapter 3). This is where the database password leaves your machine.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant c_support_app as Support assistant app
  participant c_context_retriever as Context Retriever
  participant c_redis_db as Your Redis database
  c_support_app->>c_context_retriever: POST /context-surfaces: data model, REDIS_URL (admin key)
  c_support_app->>c_context_retriever: POST agent-keys (admin key)
  c_context_retriever-->>c_support_app: agent key and mcp_url, 90-day expiry
  c_support_app->>c_context_retriever: POST data: customers, products, orders
  c_context_retriever->>c_redis_db: write JSON records and indexes
```
